'''Zonedancer Gang''' was a criminal gang operating on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. In [[3643 BBY]] they were looting the [[Mutotech Labs]] where many of the Zonedancers were killed by [[Cipher Nine]].<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Zonedancer Gang appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during Imperial Agent class mission on Nar Shaddaa.
